title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 Deligne record with Paper 84 English translation continuation
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so that Deligne material can be cited, revised, or removed independently without disturbing the rest of the archive.

The top-level files are reader-facing: one combined English translation draft PDF, 90 individually downloadable original-language reference PDFs with human-readable paper titles, and the latest separate paper-level English translation supplement for Paper 84. The artifact ZIP contains individual English PDFs, TeX/source files, source slices, reports, render checks where present, and compact provenance packages.

Status at a glance. [##########] 90/90 original-language paper PDFs staged; [#####-----] 43/90 English-ready or working-English PDFs found locally or promoted as separate paper-level supplements; Paper 84 now has a full working English translation with source slice and TeX in the artifact ZIP. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Workflow provenance: public scans and source witnesses are converted into TeX by automated transcription systems, checked and organized locally, then packaged here with source artifacts so readers can inspect, correct, and reuse the work. The public organization is by paper and work status, not by internal run name.
notes: Standalone Deligne record linked to the main public manuscript corpus. Latest update adds the Paper 84 English translation supplement and preserves the TeX, source slice, and render checks in the artifact ZIP.
